title: Local lifting from an epic cycle-pullback comparison
statement: Let $E,F$ be cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] in an abelian category, $\epsilon:E\to F$ a chain map and $i\in\mathbf Z$. Set $d=d_E^{i+1}$, $f=d_F^i$, $g:\ker d\to F^{i+1}$ equal to the kernel inclusion followed by $\epsilon^{i+1}$. Suppose $e:E^i\to F^i\times_{F^{i+1}}\ker d$ is epic, its first projection equals $\epsilon^i$, and its second projection followed by the kernel inclusion equals $d_E^i$. For every object $B$, cycle $x:B\to E^{i+1}$ and $y:B\to F^i$ with $x\epsilon^{i+1}=y d_F^i$, there exist an epimorphism $p:B^{\prime}\to B$ and $z:B^{\prime}\to E^i$ with $z\epsilon^i=py$ and $z d_E^i=px$.

proof.text: Factor x through the kernel of the next differential using kernel.lift and hx. The compatibility equation identifies y followed by the target differential with that factor followed by the map from the kernel to the next target term. Form a:B to the pullback using pullback.lift. Its projections recover y and the kernel factor by pullback.lift_fst and pullback.lift_snd.

Take B prime to be pullback e a, p its second projection and z its first projection. The Mathlib instance Abelian.epi_pullback_of_epi_f gives Epi p. The pullback condition gives z followed by e equal to p followed by a. Postcompose with the first projection and use he1 to obtain the augmentation equation. Postcompose with the second projection and kernel inclusion and use he2 and kernel.lift_ι to obtain the differential equation.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 05T7 (1), local lifting via kernel factorization and pullback stability of epimorphisms

mathlib_searches.query: Functorial bounded above complex construction by epimorphic covers of pullbacks of kernels
An epimorphic cover of the pullback of the next cycles gives local lifting of compatible cycles in a bounded above complex
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, led by CochainComplex.cm5b.degreewiseEpiWithInjectiveKernel_p and CochainComplex.cm5b. These require enough injectives and give a different construction; no fixed-T bounded-above construction.

Mathlib CategoryTheory.Abelian.Basic supplies epi_pullback_of_epi_f. Kernels supplies kernel.lift_ι; HasPullback supplies pullback.lift_fst and pullback.lift_snd. Library search finds the assigned construction and its BoundedFlatReplacement caller, but no alternative construction. These Mathlib lemmas prove the local lifting step, not the recursive existence.

from.place: the bounded-above flat replacement in the proof of the K-flat resolution lemma: Functorial cycle-pullback construction from an epimorphic cover

lean.statement:
theorem cyclePullback_lifting_pointwise {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    {E F : CochainComplex A ℤ} (ε : E ⟶ F) (i : ℤ)
    (e : E.X i ⟶ pullback (F.d i (i + 1))
      (kernel.ι (E.d (i + 1) (i + 1 + 1)) ≫ ε.f (i + 1)))
    [Epi e]
    (he₁ : e ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = ε.f i)
    (he₂ : e ≫ pullback.snd _ _ ≫ kernel.ι _ = E.d i (i + 1))
    (B : A) (x : B ⟶ E.X (i + 1)) (y : B ⟶ F.X i)
    (hx : x ≫ E.d (i + 1) (i + 1 + 1) = 0)
    (hy : x ≫ ε.f (i + 1) = y ≫ F.d i (i + 1)) :
    ∃ (B' : A) (p : B' ⟶ B) (_ : Epi p) (z : B' ⟶ E.X i),
      z ≫ ε.f i = p ≫ y ∧ z ≫ E.d i (i + 1) = p ≫ x
